Generated Narrative: ValueSet fiji-condition-code-vs

This value set includes codes based on the following rules:

  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where expression = < 404684003 |Clinical finding| AND ^ 10811000132104 |International Patient Summary reference set|
  • Include codes fromhttp://snomed.info/sct version Not Stated (use latest from terminology server) where expression = < 243796009 |Situation with explicit context| AND ^ 10811000132104 |International Patient Summary reference set|

name: FijiConditionCodeVS
title: Condition/Diagnosis code valueset
description:
Condition Code valueset for Fiji Core. 
Proposed valueset is taken from SNOMED codes curated for International Patient Summary.
Includes "clinical finding"  codes and codes for "situation with explicit content".
